formulas.momentum: 26-week trailing price return, cross-sectionally z-scored and clipped to [-2, 2]; multiply held risky ETF weights by exp(strength * score)
formulas.cash_redeployment: Redeploy the configured fraction of BIL equally to SPY and QQQ only when both have positive 26-week momentum and close above their 43-week SMA
formulas.execution: Signals use prices through decision row t; resulting weights earn t-to-t+1 returns
formulas.risk_constraint: Reapply the frozen 35% risky-ETF cap and fund residual weight with BIL

decision_rule: A passing candidate enters the research shortlist only. No candidate is promoted to production from these already-seen windows.
scope_limits: This is a six-candidate bounded search, not an optimizer over overlay parameters.
The post-2024 window is validation-like but was already observed before this test.
No live trading or capital deployment.
